text:
Leah (CSM): Heads-up — Obsidian Labs asked to onboard a custom domain model (ca. 35B, int8/qat) to handle clinical notes. They want PHI passthrough, HSM keywrap, and a private deployment. Renewal for this account is in 6 weeks; CS flagged this as high-risk if we miss delivery. :warning:
Diego (Solutions Eng): Do we have their model artifact yet? format? ONNX/ggml/pt?
Leah (CSM): They uploaded a tar to the S3 intake link earlier today — looks like TorchScript + quant config. Link posted in the intake ticket.
Samir (ML Eng): FYI int8 can work but we'll need profiling. Questions: max seq len, expected QPS, latency SLO, and will they accept quantized accuracy delta?
Leah (CSM): Seq len typical ~2k tokens for notes. QPS low — bursty during night batch jobs. Latency SLO is strict for UI flows: p95 < 400ms. They said slight drop in accuracy OK if we document.
Priya (Security): For PHI we need HSM-backed keys and no model weights leaving customer VPC. Also request audit logs and KMS policy. Is customer on Private or Dedicated?
Leah (CSM): They want Private (VPC + onprem HSM). Sales already emailed legal for DPA/BAA.
Diego (Solutions Eng): That simplifies infra — private control plane + dedicated GPU pool in their VPC. We'll need an onboarding checklist: network peering, firewall ports, HSM certs, and canary plan.
Samir (ML Eng): Proposed rollout: 1) offline eval on our eval harness 2) safety checklist (PHI leakage tests + red-team prompts) 3) perf profiling on a smaller dev pool 4) canary to 5% traffic in Private cluster -> ramp.
Samir (ML Eng): Quick eval command I'll run (example):
```
python eval_harness.py --model /intake/obsidian/35b_qat.pt --prompts prompts/clinical_safe_set.json --metrics ppl,exact_match,levenshtein --output results/obsidian_eval.json
```
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll prep a dedicated nodepool with T4x2 for profiling, then move to A100s for production. Need estimate of GPU hours.
Leah (CSM): I'll ask the customer for expected daily tokens and a list of critical prompts they consider "must-pass". Also collecting legal docs.
Priya (Security): Add these mandatory items before deploy: HSM keywrap proof, KMS integration test, retention policy confirmation, and privacy-preserving logging (token redaction). I'll also need a sensitivity matrix from the customer.
Leah (CSM): They're okay with limited logging but want end-to-end traceability for audit. I'll capture that in the ticket.
Samir (ML Eng): Heads-up: 2k seq + 35B even quantized might struggle to hit p95 400ms on smaller GPUs. We'll propose model sharding + KV cache + prefix caching. Also consider a distilled 13B variant as fallback to meet latency SLOs.
Leah (CSM): Customer prefers single model but is open to fallbacks if we explain behavior.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Can we do an A/B rollout using Redwood's routing? Canary -> fallback policy to 13B if latency > 600ms or error rate > 1%.
Priya (Security): Also require eval results for PHI redaction tests. We'll define test prompts with synthetic PHI and expect zero leakage.
Leah (CSM): Renewal note: I'll mark account as "at-risk" in CRM until we've confirmed timeline. Sarah on renewals flagged this as a priority.
Samir (ML Eng): I'll start offline eval tomorrow and post results here. If numbers look bad we can propose quantization tweaks or a distilled model.
Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll create the infra ticket and the private cluster blueprint.
deploy-bot: New intake created: CS-4782 (Obsidian Labs) — assigned to Leah, Diego, Samir. Intake link: https://redwood.example.com/intake/CS-4782 :white_check_mark:
Leah (CSM): Thanks — I'll update the customer and schedule a 30m enablement call for next Tue (00:00 UTC tentative). Anyone want to join? :calendar:
Samir (ML Eng): I'll join for the eval review.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Count me in for the infra bits.
Priya (Security): I'll come for the PHI/security checklist signoff.
Leah (CSM): Great — note to self: collect must-pass prompts, SLO acceptance window, and confirm HSM cert date. I'll post an updated timeline after the eval. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
